title: Filter payment history
body: Switch between all payments, Expenses, and income to focus the history on one type of transaction. The selected filter affects the rows and totals you review.

title: Record cash payment
body: Record a cash transaction so it appears alongside other payment history. Enter the correct amount and context because this creates a financial record for the account.

title: Manage payment methods
body: Open saved payment methods to add, Review, or update a card. These methods are used by eligible checkout flows and are managed separately from past transactions.

title: Filter by member
body: Open the member list and use + to select one member. Confirm an empty selection to show All. The filter changes the list while your overall payment totals stay available.

title: Currency totals
body: Open the currency summary to compare incoming and outgoing amounts. This gives context for the individual records shown below.

title: Payment records
body: Review payments and refunds in date order. Open a row menu for the transaction’s available details and actions.

title: Payment and refund record
body: Read the amount, direction and date together. A refund has its own record; a failed attempt does not mean the payment was captured.

title: Transaction state
body: The state distinguishes captured, failed and refunded payments. A pending refund still needs a decision; it is not yet a completed repayment.

title: Payment record actions
body: Open a transaction’s menu to inspect or manage that record. Payment history is separate from the saved methods used for future checkouts.

title: Delete a cash record
body: Remove an incorrectly recorded cash receipt after confirmation. Deleting the record does not itself transfer money back to the payer.

title: Return without submitting
body: Closes this screen. Closing is separate from Save, sending a request or confirming a payment; use the relevant action when you intend to submit.
